messages:
Riley Kim: Heads-up — customer Ridgewell Health (RW-307) reported partial activation failures during their midnight import (02:05 UTC). Need a concise customer status and office hours.
Farah Ahmed: paste top errors pls
Riley Kim: support logs show `ingest: upstream 502` and `shard warm timeout` repeated several times.
Ethan Brooks: likely cache-warm/backpressure on their shard. Mitigation: 1) disable continuous batching for RW-307, 2) warm shard cache with increased concurrency, 3) replay failed chunks at reduced batch size. Steps 1+2 in ~30-45m, replay ~2.0-3.0h.
EngBot: Incident INC-RW-307-2026 created, severity=P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-ops.
Farah Ahmed: Draft to customer (short): "Hi Ridgewell — were aware a portion of your activation import failed this morning. Root cause: cache warmup and API backpressure during a large batch. What were doing: disabling continuous batching (ETA ~45m), warming your shard and replaying failed items (ETA ~3h). We will dedupe writes and rate-limit replays to avoid duplicates. Office hours: Thu 08:00 PT or Thu 17:00 CET. Well apply a temporary credit and follow up with an RCA within 72 hours. Reply with priority seat IDs."
CSM - Prieto: Sent to Ridgewell (ticket #99021). Customer replied: "Please prioritize seats 701/702. Office hours Thu 08:00 PT works."
Riley Kim: Actions: @Ethan disable batching + change cache concurrency (ETA 45m). @Prieto send invite and surface per-tenant progress widget. @Farah prepare 2-line exec summary for buyer. Credits to be applied within 24h.
Ethan Brooks: Change applied: continuous batching disabled for RW-307 at 1807660200. Cache warming started.
Ethan Brooks: Replay started; first tranche raised activations from ~48% -> ~82%. Monitoring in place; rate-limited dedupe enabled.
Farah Ahmed: Exec blurb suggestion: "Partial ingestion disruption for Ridgewell due to cache warmup contention during a large import. Immediate mitigations applied; replay and validation underway; temporary credit and RCA committed."
CSM - Prieto: Buyer notified and office hours invite sent. Customer confirmed priority seats.
Riley Kim: Timeline: customer-friendly summary in 8h, full RCA draft in 72h, credits within 24h. Keeping this thread as the single source for customer-facing updates. React when seen. :white_check_mark:
Ethan Brooks: :white_check_mark:
Farah Ahmed: :thumbsup:
